hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Sort the array to align elements from smallest to largest.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Form pairs by coupling opposite ends: nums[i] with nums[n - 1 - i].

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Compute the greatest common divisor for each symmetric pair and sum the results.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import math

def sumOfGcdPairs(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    nums.sort()
    n = len(nums)
    total = 0
    for i in range(n // 2):
        total += math.gcd(nums[i], nums[n - 1 - i])
    return total
```

complexity.notes: Sorting takes O(n log n) and computing n // 2 greatest common divisors takes O(n log(max_val)).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all n^2 pairs violates the specified symmetric pairing rule.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorts in place with constant auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Pairs symmetric opposite ends and applies Euclidean gcd algorithm.
